name: traj
meaning: the trajectory: u16 count then count Vec3s (0x45981d)

name: pointIndex
meaning: index of the point being steered toward; steps by +1 or -1 depending on forward (0x4598d6)

name: speed
meaning: speed in units/s multiplying the normalised direction (0x4599bc)

name: headingBias
meaning: constant added to the atan2 heading (0x459a29); 0x800 here

name: heading
meaning: cached 12-bit heading toward the current point (0x459a64)

name: arriveRadiusSq
meaning: squared arrival radius (0x4597a5 squares the init argument)

name: continuousHeading
meaning: recompute the heading every step instead of only on a point change (0x459a20)

name: use3dDistance
meaning: include the vertical axis in the distance and the output velocity (0x45985a)

name: moving
meaning: set to 1 by every step and to 0 by init (0x459810)

name: advanced
meaning: 1 when a point was consumed during this step (0x4598ff)

name: forward
meaning: 1 = walk the points forwards, 0 = backwards; init sets 1 (0x4597ec) and the Gossamer flips it when a move is blocked (0x452c0d)

name: forceAdvance
meaning: one-shot: makes the next step consume a point whatever the distance (0x4598ac); set when blocked and when the flee starts (0x454163)
